03 / THE MATERIAL UNIVERSE

What exists, and what it becomes.

Representative physical constituents and pathways, not a census of every molecule or isotope. Presence does not imply equal abundance.

The Big Bang made light nuclei. Most heavier elements came later through several overlapping processes. Select an element to inspect its origins. This atlas spans cosmic history; it does not imply every element existed in the selected era.

118 elements · all shown

Groups run from 1 to 18. The two detached rows contain elements 57–71 and 89–103. Use arrow keys within the table; Enter selects. On a small screen, scroll the table sideways. Search highlights matches without rearranging the table.
